Staff Software Engineer (Backend and Platform)

We're Example Systems. Our company enjoys discussing Kubernetes and sharing pictures of vacations.
Our culture includes outdoor activities and team events.
You’re comfortable explaining technical decisions and mentoring engineers.

You’ll fit right in if:
You collaborate with engineering and product teams to clarify ambiguous projects.

‍What You’ll Do:
Build TypeScript and React applications for clients.
Mentor engineers and improve code review practices.
Build employee benefits APIs using Python and FastAPI.

Who Should Apply?
You have at least five years of professional software development experience.
You have familiarity with Kubernetes and Terraform.

Why Example Systems?
Our company sponsors conferences, hobby groups, and team retreats.

Company benefits:
Healthcare:
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Health savings account (HSA)
Flexible spending account (FSA)
Retirement:
401(k) plan with 4% employer match
Paid Time Off:
20 days vacation a year
